worlds.name: Two Eyes
worlds.teaser: A phone sees a muddy river; a satellite sees the scar upstream.
worlds.body: Two Eyes pairs a citizen's phone video with Sentinel-2 imagery, turning them into a dated, shareable evidence card on likely mining sources. Made with SAM 3.1 and Muse Spark for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon, 2026.

worlds.name: Atmo
worlds.teaser: An AI companion for climate questions — from Article 6 to adaptation finance.
worlds.body: An AI companion for climate questions. Ask it anything from Article 6 to adaptation finance and get a grounded, readable answer.

worlds.name: VentureQuest
worlds.teaser: A game about starting a climate venture — face the trade-offs founders face.
worlds.body: A game about starting a climate venture: you face the choices real founders face and live with the trade-offs.

worlds.name: Carbon Markets for SMEs
worlds.teaser: What it would take for small Ghanaian businesses and communities to join carbon markets on fair terms.
worlds.body: Ongoing research into what it would take for small Ghanaian businesses and communities to take part in carbon markets on fair terms.

worlds.name: notify-crossx
worlds.teaser: A desktop ping when your AI coding agent is done — and only when you've stepped away.
worlds.body: A small utility for people who work with AI coding agents: a desktop ping when the agent is done or needs you, and only when you've stepped away. Free for OpenCode, with a Claude Code edition.
